This behavior communicates that the coach doesn't trust clients and needs to constantly intervene. 3e9206d2f5.q: How does client celebration frequency affect a coach's ability to sell their offer authentically?
3e9206d2f5.a: Jill noticed a stark difference in how she sold based on whether clients were sharing wins that week. When she received screenshots of client results, she would sell with maximum power and conviction. But when the wins channel was empty for a couple weeks, she couldn't talk about the offer with the same belief, thinking clients weren't doing well. This fear of selling without perfect client results undermined her power and effectiveness in marketing.
